label: B25-QUARTUS-SYNTHESIS-PARALLEL-AB
title: Measure and adopt safe Quartus synthesis parallelism
scope: Use fresh isolated probes to explain and improve the long single-root synthesis wall time. Test one variable per probe: processor ceiling only, explicit top-level design partitions with Auto effort, then FAST effort only if needed. Never reuse an experimental result as signoff without full fitter/STA and source provenance.
rules: Do not assign soc|coh together with nested i_l1/d_l1/l2 partitions in the same variant.
First use a bounded worker-spawn probe to observe internal --parallel=N; do not spend a full 6-hour run on a variant that still reports only one root worker unless it is the control.
NUM_PARALLEL_PROCESSORS alone is a ceiling and must not be claimed to split root_partition.
SYNTHESIS_EFFORT FAST is unverified in this repository and must be isolated from partition changes.
A variant is adoptable only if synthesis wall time improves materially, peak memory is safe, and full fitter/STA plus T-011 timing/CDC/UCP checks pass.
acceptance: At least one source-reproducible variant demonstrates measured wall-time improvement without timing/resource/CDC/waiver regression, or evidence proves the single-root bottleneck cannot be improved safely with these settings.
resource: Every remote probe uses the gamepc resource lock; variants are serial, task-local and event-driven.
forbidden: changing functional RTL or SDC to improve compile time
combining partition and FAST variables before single-variable evidence
overwriting T-013 or prior remote probes
